faq.question: What does Itri mean?
faq.answer: Itri is associated with the Amazigh form إِيتْرِي, whose core sense is itri; star (amazigh).

faq.question: What is the origin of Itri?
faq.answer: Itri is associated with Amazigh. Itri is Amazigh (Berber), meaning 'star'.

faq.question: Is Itri an Arabic name?
faq.answer: No — the underlying form is Amazigh, not Arabic.

faq.question: Is Itri an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Itri can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Amazigh-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Itri a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Itri should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Itri is an Amazigh word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.question: What does Itri mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Itri is rendered ایتری and carries the sense ایتری، ستاره.

faq.question: How is Itri pronounced?
faq.answer: A romanized syllable approximation is it-ri. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.answer: Romanization variants include Itri, itri. Script forms are إِيتْرِي, ايتري, ایتری, इत्री.
